adaptivePublication.controls: Freeze the control object, complete definition and precision across retries; forbid per-step cable overrides; validate raw states and duration before conversion.
adaptivePublication.mutationPolicy: Isolate helper inputs; reject changed state/control, original step core or complete normalized publication report, including replaced energy payloads, before journal publication. Preserve rollback and accepted prefixes.
adaptivePublication.reportTrustLimit: Fresh cable checks validate the cable contribution; existing non-cable solver stationarity and report terms remain trusted numerical inputs.
adaptivePublication.work: Compute complete fixed-parameter cable work before every accepted journal outcome even without an external schedule. Re-evaluate numerical before/after/work responses from the immutable control.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: Rounded zero gradient or a negative nominal floating dot product can hide unresolved cable uncertainty.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Use exact uncertainty-aware stationarity and directional intervals; unresolved descent rejects.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: Subtracting binary endpoints may round a real displacement, and reconstructing an endpoint can change the path being checked.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Compute directional products from exact binary endpoint differences and pass the actual candidate endpoint to cable-path guards.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: Finite energy metadata can be internally consistent while shifted endpoint energies or a one-ULP fixed-work value are forged.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Fresh immutable-control numerical comparisons supplement metadata, aggregate and interval checks before adaptive publication.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: Final validation helpers could mutate the journal-bound core or mutate/replace the energy report after earlier checks.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Snapshot the complete normalized report, compare it after fresh numerical validation and perform the final original-core/control checks before publication.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: An inexact integer duration could silently narrow during adaptive arithmetic.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Apply strict binary64 duration admission before arithmetic; Boolean duration rejection is also retained.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: A zero-activation test incorrectly expected exactly static native rest geometry.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Compare against a separate no-cable baseline; retain the native float32 rest relaxation instead of changing mechanics.

adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.finding: A helper test assumed np.longdouble was wider than binary64 on macOS ARM.
adversarialFindingsAndRepairs.repair: Reject only genuinely wider formats; the platform alias is admissible. No mechanical producer change.

Later publication holes were review findings fixed before their new regressions, not historical failed numerical runs.

energyAccounting.aggregation: Mechanical change and both work remainders sum the recorded existing binary64 terms and cable terms exactly before one final rounding. The report separately retains cable endpoint energy certificates and exact rational error/assembly bounds.

energyAccounting.workPolicy: Use cancellation-resistant primitive fixed-parameter work, including tiny signed changes when endpoint energy midpoints round equal. Endpoint/work intervals must overlap consistently.

integrationPolicy.admission: Both optional arguments together; exact immutable recipe type; matching vertex count; all-free positive-mass model; guarded direct solver only. Empty legacy rows and separately declared existing point seams are both supported.
integrationPolicy.controls: Targets, density, reference measure and activation are fixed. The separate primitive law and anchor-conversion defects are retained in complete control descriptions; no implicit old-row replacement or renormalization.
integrationPolicy.curvature: Slack-sided generalized cable curvature is added once to both assembled search metrics. Both metrics retain positive-definiteness/descent safeguards and physical-inertia fallback; entrywise rounding bounds do not prove the matrix PSD or a classical total Hessian.
integrationPolicy.lineSearch: For the exact displacement between actual binary endpoints, slope upper must be negative and work upper must be at most binary64(1e-4) times slope lower. Cable work uncertainty and final addition rounding are included.
integrationPolicy.pathGuards: Existing triangle/contact guards and explicit fold-actuator/angular-barrier hinge guards remain. Cable calls use the actual candidate endpoint, including physical checks after optimization. Passive bending does not acquire a general new swept branch certificate.
integrationPolicy.precision: All four positive binary64 absolute tolerances and five integer arithmetic budgets are explicit and fixed for the entire adaptive run. Unresolved precision or resource exhaustion rejects; no automatic precision refinement or relaxed acceptance.
integrationPolicy.scope: Bounds are conditional on the existing binary64 non-cable force and work terms. No independent bound on every existing mechanical term, geometry computation or physical force is claimed.
integrationPolicy.stationarity: Exact binary64 gradient infinity norm plus cable maximum component error plus final cable-addition rounding must be at most binary64(1e-6) N.
